captions.instagram:
A full wall of IKEA PAX in Haringey, made to look built in.

Three PAX frames, an MDF box on top of each up to the ceiling, an end panel from the floor to the ceiling and twelve panelled doors. The joints in the top doors line up with the joints below, so the lines run straight up the wall.

Want to do yours yourself? My 22-page guide, IKEA PAX, built in, has the sums, the cut list and every step. Link in bio.
